dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: One prominent, high-contrast white horizontal band visible across the greater coverts; a secondary, thinner and less distinct pale band is visible on the median coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, narrow pale-gray to white edges creating distinct linear boundaries along the folded primary and secondary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Distinct semi-circular white patch on the posterior neck, providing high contrast against the black crown.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp, distinct boundary between the black crown and the grayish mantle, interrupted centrally by a white nape patch.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast white auricular/cheek patches visible on the sides of the head.
